strings.subtitle: — Amḥay n Ifuyla —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Aǧǧer ur yelli. Sqedc taqeffalt n wadda.
strings.ssd_warning: Ɛqel! Ɣef SSD, s TRIM, adis-a ur ittḥa. Ahil-a ɣer HDD wala.
strings.confirm_text:
Afuyl "{name}" ad ittwarmeḍ udi ittuḥa.

Kemmel?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS (ADS) ur ittwaxdem.
• USN ur ittwazdeg.
• Ttuliwin n tili udi aseḍfer n usigna
  (OneDrive udi wayeḍ) ur ttwaxemmem.
strings.status_full: Agbur ittwarmeḍ s zéro. Aɣrar ur yezmir — ifecka ẓrin zéro wala.
strings.status_fast: Aqerru, aneggaru udi 4 MB ittwarmeḍ. Wayeḍ ur ittwaxemmem, maca s tɣuriwin, aɣrar n ufuyl ur yezmir. Ɛerḍen ADIS AČČURAN i twaragiwin.
strings.status_empty: Afuyl ixwi, armad ur yehwaǧ. Ittuḥa.
strings.error_permission: Ur yezmir ad yekcem ɣer ufuyl. Yezmer ad yili yeldi deg uhil wayeḍ. Mdel udi ɛerḍ tikkelt nniḍen.
strings.error_not_found: Afuyl ur yufi. Yezmer ittuḥa yakan.
strings.error_is_symlink: Wa d abrid azamul. Ibriden ur ttwaḥan — afuyl n wawal ad yeqqim.
strings.error_reparse: Wa d afuyl n wakud (OneDrive niɣ ames). Isefka-s deg usigna, mačči deg uḍebsi — ulac acu ad yeḥlu.
strings.error_not_file: Wa mačči d afuyl (takarḍa niɣ wayeḍ). Ɛǧǧer afuyl.
strings.error_hardlinks: Afuyl-a yesɛa ibriden iqbuṛen wayeḍ ({n} akk). Ibriden iqbuṛen ur sɛin abrid amenzu — akk ismawen d yiwet. Ma tḥa s ubrid-a, isefka ad ittwarmeḍ udi ad ittwaɣz ɣer 32 byte, maca stub ad yeqqim s ibriden wayeḍ. Ḥu akk ibriden zik.
strings.error_compressed:
Afuyl ittwaknes, ittwawgel niɣ d arif. Armad s zéro ur ittḥa isefka iqdimen, acku NTFS ittwakkes-it s wiyaḍ.

Kkes talsert: aqric ɣer yefus → Talsert → Amaynut → kkes "Knes" udi/niɣ "Gel". Sinna sqedc SHREDDER tikkelt nniḍen.
